# ladder-max

The floor on each ladder value of Max: every credit the plan sells (its top-up rate, and
its monthly and yearly fee over the bundled credits, net of VAT and payment fees) must earn at
least 2x the dearest checking action's cost per credit (a photo scan, 2p for 15 credits:
0.2667p). Each refused change below breaks that; the accepted one keeps it. Net fee = gross ÷ 1.2
− (2.7% × gross + 20p) (docs/design/pricing-model.md, "Unit economics").

Retiring the 1-minute watching price is refused too: Max's floor of 1 minute would have no price to buy it with.
